inventoryFromActualPixels.observation: One four-sided slanted plate footprint, with a rising lower-left to upper-right incidence face and a roughly parallel exit face below it; seven short dark hatch marks lie inside. No grid, scale, measured length or numerical angle is visible.

A names the upper-right terminal dot. The thick incident trace slopes down-left to B on the incidence face. The thick internal trace runs nearly downwards, slightly right, to C on the exit face. A thick emergent trace from C runs down-left. A separate thinner, nearly vertical continuation of BC runs below C, slightly right. B and C are named boundary intersections; the source does not need additional discrete point dots at those intersections.

A thinner solid diagonal runs from upper-left through B to lower-right, crossing the exit face to the right of C. It is distinct from the thick ray and from the thin BC extension. No arrowheads or right-angle square are visible.

An upper short arc centered at B joins the upper normal branch to BA outside the plate, with an a/alpha-shaped archival glyph above it. A second short arc centered at B lies inside the plate between BC and the lower normal branch, with a beta-shaped glyph below/right. The exact original upper glyph codepoint is not resolved; modern alpha and beta are justified by the authoritative prose, not by guessing its encoding.
One small isolated round dark mark lies left and slightly above the B region. It has no visible label or stated instructional role.
